shouldFix.title: The Claude v2 pin omits advisory observation O-1 despite the full-roster promise
shouldFix.subjectEvidence: pinChainRule says every pin record enumerates the full blocker, shouldFix, and advisory roster of the pinned file, but claude2v2.advisories is []. The collision note names Claude v1 observations O-1/O-2 but does not name Claude v2 observation O-1.
shouldFix.sourceEvidence: The pinned frozen Claude v2 review at 4255ed77... contains observations[0] with id O-1 and severity ADVISORY-NON-BLOCKING. That observation is the duplicate-LIVE-standing issue that v3 substantively repairs by changing recordedInputs.governingSources[2].standing to NAMED-PROPERTIES-ONLY.
shouldFix.impact: The mechanics contract is unaffected, but the successor's explicit complete-provenance assertion is false. The omission also leaves two lane-distinct O-1 identifiers across Claude v1 and Claude v2 indistinguishable in the stated collision inventory.
shouldFix.fix: Add O-1 to appliesFindingsOf.claude2v2.advisories and record it as resolved by the NAMED-PROPERTIES-ONLY change, using a lane-qualified reference where needed to distinguish it from Claude v1 O-1. notFoldedThisSuccessor may remain empty once that disposition is explicit.
shouldFix.severityReasoning: SHOULD-FIX because this is a reproducible lineage and accuracy defect of the same class as CODEX-V2-S1, not an authority escape, source-carry corruption, invented API, or implementation authorization.
